title: platform-standup-2026-03-05
content:
Date: 2026-03-05
Attendees: Noah Patel (owner), Maya Singh, Luis Gomez, Hannah Park, Owen Li, SRE oncall: Priya Reddy

Quick updates
- Control plane: Maya
  - Rolled out new config reconciliation loop to 25% of clusters. Observed target reconciliation latency drop median from 2.2s -> 1.1s. One cluster (eu-west-2) showed occasional 5-7s spikes; root cause appears to be k8s API proxy rate limiting.
  - Next: add backoff jitter and metrics for proxy 429s (PLT-342). Blocking: need kube client lib upgrade tested in staging (PR linked).

- Routing: Luis
  - Smart routing rollout completed for Dedicated pools A/B. Saw 3% lower cost per token for long-tail workloads. Need to adjust fallback thresholds: current CPU threshold too aggressive causing unnecessary model fallbacks during short bursts.
  - Action: tweak threshold + monitor for 48h (PLT-351).

- Auth & Quotas: Hannah
  - Quota service v1.3 deployed; new per-customer rate limits and token-bucket implementation. Found an edge case where quota resets at midnight UTC cause bursts for customers on heavy night schedules.
  - Temporary mitigation: smoothing window added; long-term: move to sliding-window counters. Created ticket and RFC.

- Observability / Alerts: Owen
  - Added dashboards for reconcile-latency and routing fallback rate. Set pager thresholds: >5% fallback rate for 15m triggers paging to oncall.
  - Observability gap: no user-facing incident links in routing alerts. TODO: add permalink to affected customers list in alert payload.

Oncall notes
- Priya: investigated a routing incident 03/04 23:10 UTC where customers in us-west saw increased errors. Root cause: misconfigured autoscaler for Dedicated pool causing capacity churn. Mitigation steps documented in incident draft; follow-up 1) capacity pooling fix, 2) add autoscaler-scaling grace period flag.

Decisions
- Defer moving to sliding-window quota counters until after the client lib upgrade; implement smoothing window as interim.
- Prioritize kube client lib upgrade to resolve control plane proxy 429s; tagging as P1 for this sprint.

Action items
- Maya: finish kube client lib upgrade test in staging and open canary PR by 2026-03-07 (PLT-342).
- Luis: adjust fallback CPU threshold and monitor for 48h, report in next standup.
- Hannah: write RFC for sliding-window counters and post to #platform-architecture by 2026-03-09.
- Owen: add customer permalink to routing alerts and coordinate with CS to ensure correct formatting.
- Priya: finalize incident postmortem draft and link in Confluence; schedule blameless review session.

Open questions / blockers
- Is the current Dedicated autoscaler behavior acceptable for predictable latency? Need longer term plan to reduce capacity churn. (proposal: rate-limit scale-downs per pool)
- Are there any compliance constraints for changing quota reset semantics (sliding-window)? Hannah will check with security/compliance.

Notes to self
- Check if the cost-savings from smart routing holds for low-latency SLO customers; may need per-customer routing policy.
- Follow up with infra on k8s API proxy configuration for eu-west-2.

Linked tickets & PRs
- PLT-342 (kube client upgrade and proxy 429)
